procedure.base: the final-file candidate chosen after configs/sixmonth_devmonths_v1.json's reading (candidate 4 or the month-spliced candidate 5); applied LAST, after the LIRF cap (the cap moves only fill-population rows, which this layer never moves)

procedure.mapping_bias_noise_gate_shift: tools/run_published_means_v3.py, candidate pm_np, unchanged: mapping from the twelve 2025 months (LIRF without its fill population); method bias and noise from v72's development values over the four development months; eligible if u <= the 2025 maximum + 0.02, sigma <= 5 s and |level - bias| >= 3 sigma; shift = (level - bias) x max(0, 1 - sigma^2 / (level - bias)^2)
procedure.rows: non-fixed rows with a value in (0, 7200] s of an eligible cell move by -shift, floor -12 s, rounded to the nearest integer into the base dtype; fixed rows never move and are left out of LIRF's means
